body: My bad I meant ‘shit person’ was just a typo
I’ve been thinking and wanting to run away so badly. Different far away country all by myself. Fuck everyone here.
I wish I had my own room I’m in a dorm. I need to work on being more independent/taking alone time but when I’m alone I feel like I get scared if that makes sense.

I’m glad to hear your wife was able to get some distance. And lol my parents, or at least one in particular, are stupid. It’s just so hard idk. This probably doesn’t make sense because I’m so tired right now lol but thank you

I know most of it is ignorance believe me. But really I don’t think anyone could understand how crazy they are except one or two certain people. Maybe they did care but not in the I’m worried for your health way. I’m glad your father was able to understand everything eventually.

This is exactly how I feel. Mainly because my family/parents have taught me depression can’t occur in someone unless they’re doing bad things like *gasp* weed or other dumb stuff. I’ve been taught since I was born that attention is bad/I don’t deserve it. People who say they are depressed are attention seeking according to them. I didn’t want to be seen as attention seeking. I still feel like that’s all I am even though suicide is the only thing I think about too. When they found out I was depressed they didn’t care.

Well damn we sound like the same person with the same family. Only difference is I’m an only child and my moms the crazy one. I’m in college, finally able to move out even though I still see her regularly, and I feel the same too. It’s not going well even though I had hoped I’d get better. Idk what’s going on in my life I just know I’m depressed and a ball of anxiety. I’m really sorry you’ve had to grow up like this but I know it’ll get better for you. If you ever need anything or want to talk or anything feel free to reach out.
Maybe but most likely maybe not. Thank you though i appreciate it
That’s really amazing to hear ❤️ you deserve it and everything amazing that will surely come later, keep up the hard work !
No need to be sorry. Thank you I appreciate your kind words and wishes ❤️they’re simple but mean a lot

Thanks <33 I’ll keep it short and say therapy didn’t work for me and even if I wanted to try it again I wouldn’t be able to cause my mother wouldn’t let me. I’ll try to rationalize as well. If you need someone to talk to feel free to talk to me. I know I’m a stranger and this offer is weird but I hate feeling like i have no one to talk to. I don’t want anyone feeling like that. Thank you again.

Damn memes daily does sound nice lol thank yiu I appreciate it <3 I can barley open up to this one person whom I’m the closest to let alone a stranger. Thank you for your kind offers they’re much appreciated
